name: Candy-striped Claytonia
desc: Candy-striped Claytonia (Claytonia sibirica): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 547 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Claytonia sibirica is a flowering plant in the family Montiaceae, commonly known as pink purslane, candy flower, Siberian spring beauty or Siberian miner's lettuce. A synonym is Montia sibirica.
